map.→ 打开导览时长匹配工具: -> Open the tour duration matching tool
map.个性化导览（逐件设置时长）场景下，列出每件展品时长占比与累计时间，对比可用时间识: In a personalised tour (per-item duration setting), list each exhibit duration share and cumulative time, then compare against available time to spot the segments that overrun.
map.团队讲解排程时，按展品数、单件讲解时长、移动与开场时间估算总时长，判断是否在可用: When scheduling a guided tour, estimate the total duration from the number of exhibits, the per-item narration time, movement time and opening time, judge whether it fits the available time, and suggest trade-offs.
map.工具给出三选一：①缩短单件讲解至 ⌊(单件×可用−移动−开场)÷件数⌋ 秒；②减: The tool offers three options: 1) shorten the per-item narration to floor((per-item x available - movement - opening) / items) seconds; 2) cut the narrated exhibits to floor((available - opening) / (per-item + movement)) items; 3) compress movement time. Cut redundant exhibits and movement gaps first, and keep the highlights.
map.平均每件时长怎么用？: How is the average per-item duration used?
map.每件可用 = ⌊可用秒÷展品数⌋，用于快速判断当前单件设定是否超标；若某件远超均: Available time per item = floor(available seconds / number of items), which gives a quick read on whether the current per-item setting overruns. If one item far exceeds the average, compress it first. The per-item view also shows each item share and cumulative time, making it easy to trim precisely.
map.超时了怎么调？: How do I adjust when it overruns?
map.超时应急时，给出缩短单件讲解、减少展品数或压缩移动时间三种调控路径，保证团队整体: When time runs over, the tool offers three ways to regain control - shorten the per-item narration, reduce the number of exhibits, or compress movement time - to keep the overall pace of the team.
map.输入展品数量与各展品讲解时长（或按平均时长快速估算），计算语音导览总时长并与观众: Enter the number of exhibits and the narration time for each (or estimate quickly from an average), compute the total audio guide duration and match it against the visitors' available time; if it overruns, suggest cuts or speed-ups. Used for museum curation and narration scheduling.
map.：某团队 5 件展品、单件讲解 120 秒、移动 30 秒/段、开场结束 60: : a team has 5 exhibits, 120 s of narration per item, 30 s of movement per leg and 60 s of opening and closing, with 20 minutes available. Total = 5 x 120 + 4 x 30 + 60 = 780 s (13 minutes); available 20 x 60 = 1200 s; the difference is +420 s (7 minutes of slack); available per item = floor(1200 / 5) = 240 s. Per-item scenario: bronze ding 120 / chime bells 150 / jade bi 90 / terracotta warriors 100 / gold and silver ware 110, totalling 570 s, which against 10 minutes available (600 s) leaves only 30 s, so per-item time must be compressed or items removed.
